representation: Blender-authored semantic multipart GLB using a circular clipped orthogonal city mesh, cruciform Gothic keep, exposed canal deck, and integrated cliff waterfalls

approval.basis: inherits the user's explicit approval for the materially different Blender/multipart-GLB production route

why_distinct_from_v5: city mass is formed by clipped orthogonal wall ribbons and flat-roof basalt blocks rather than repeated cone-roof primitives
lava canals are primary negative-space/navigation bands authored before secondary structures
terrain is an asymmetric cliff crown fused directly to the city footprint rather than concentric empty terraces
the keep uses a cruciform stepped footprint and narrow buttressed tower hierarchy instead of a stacked square tower

hard_vetoes: spiky forest silhouette replacing the orthogonal city

semantic_parts_required: four cardinal gatehouses and approach stairs
runtime_rule: Do not replace the current runtime world until the naked v6 blockout passes its six-view gate.
